dialog.overviewDesc: Experience full modal behavior with backdrop blur, keyboard ESC dismissal, and focus containment across Web and Desktop.
dialog.examplesDesc: Common modal dialog patterns: desktop draggable windows, confirmation dialogs, and alert notices.
dialog.animationsDesc: Motion behavior and timing for the overlay and content on open and close.
dialog.animationsBullet1: The backdrop overlay fades in and out using animate-fade-in / animate-fade-out, over duration-short with the ease-entrance curve.
dialog.animationsBullet2: The content card cross-fades with opacity only (transform-positioned elements avoid scale animation to prevent conflicts), and exit uses useExitAnimation to delay unmounting.
dialog.animationsBullet3: Durations and easing resolve from theme tokens, so prefers-reduced-motion zeroes them automatically (Qt: governed by ThemeTokens.animationsEnabled).
dialog.animationsDescQt: Motion behavior and timing driven by ThemeTokens for the overlay and content on open and close.
dialog.animationsBullet1Qt: The root overlay and the card cross-fade between open and closed, with the card scaling subtly to emphasize entry.
dialog.animationsBullet2Qt: Transitions use ThemeTokens.motionShort with the easeEntrance curve.
dialog.animationsBullet3Qt: All transitions are guarded by ThemeTokens.animationsEnabled; when disabled, durations resolve to zero and animations stop.

dropdownMenu.overviewDesc: Click the trigger below to open the dropdown menu. Keyboard navigation and shortcuts are fully supported.

presetNumberInput.overviewDesc: Focus or click the input field to open the preset numbers list. Click an item to populate the field, or type custom numbers freely.

inlineEditableText.overviewDesc: Click or double-click on the text below to modify it. Press Enter to confirm or Esc to cancel.

sheet.overviewDesc: Choose a slide edge and size preset, then trigger the drawer modal.
sheet.animationsDesc: Motion behavior and timing for the backdrop and sliding panel.
sheet.animationsBullet1: The backdrop overlay cross-fades with animate-fade-in / animate-fade-out.
sheet.animationsBullet2: The panel slides in and out from its edge using slide-in-from-{side}-10 and slide-out-to-{side}-10, animated over duration-medium with the ease-emphasized curve.
sheet.animationsBullet3: Durations and easing resolve from theme tokens, so prefers-reduced-motion zeroes them automatically (Qt: governed by ThemeTokens.animationsEnabled).
sheet.animationsDescQt: Motion behavior and timing driven by ThemeTokens for the backdrop and sliding panel.
sheet.animationsBullet1Qt: The panel translates along its entry edge while the backdrop cross-fades its opacity.
sheet.animationsBullet2Qt: Transitions use ThemeTokens.motionMedium with the easeEmphasized curve for a deliberate slide.
sheet.animationsBullet3Qt: All transitions are guarded by ThemeTokens.animationsEnabled; when disabled, durations resolve to zero and animations stop.

snapSlider.animationsBullet1: Thumb hover and scale micro-interactions animate smoothly over duration-quick (90ms) using ease-standard curve (Qt counterpart: ThemeTokens.motionQuick and ThemeTokens.easeStandard).
snapSlider.animationsBullet2: Thumb drag kinematics track pointer position in 60fps real-time without un-damped lag.
snapSlider.animationsBullet3: Respects prefers-reduced-motion on Web and ThemeTokens.animationsEnabled in Qt.
snapSlider.keyboardDesc: Keyboard shortcuts and discrete step navigation patterns.
snapSlider.animationsDescQt: Thumb hover and focus transitions animate over ThemeTokens.motionQuick (90ms) with ThemeTokens.easeStandard. Dragging tracks pointer without lag in 60fps.

table.overviewDesc: Test interactive data table controls with live filtering, row selection, and synchronized React and Qt Quick code.
table.examplesDesc: Common table patterns and interactive configurations.
table.examplesDescQt: Common configurations and visual states in Qt Quick.

codeBlock.overviewDesc: A syntax-highlighted source viewer with a language label and one-click copy. Highlighting is produced by the shared spec lexer — no third-party highlighter is shipped on either stack.
codeBlock.animationsDesc: Motion behavior and timing for file switching and the header affordances.
codeBlock.animationsBullet1: Switching the active file cross-fades the body in over animate-in fade-in-0 — the duration resolves to the short motion token with the entrance curve.
codeBlock.animationsBullet2: The header affordances inherit token motion from their primitives: tab triggers interpolate color and border over duration-quick with ease-standard, as do the copy button and the scroll bars.
codeBlock.animationsBullet3: Durations and easing resolve from theme tokens, so prefers-reduced-motion zeroes them automatically (Qt: governed by ThemeTokens.animationsEnabled).
codeBlock.animationsDescQt: Motion behavior and timing driven by ThemeTokens for file switching and the header affordances.
codeBlock.animationsBullet1Qt: Switching the active file cross-fades the body over ThemeTokens.motionShort with the easeEntrance curve.
codeBlock.animationsBullet2Qt: The header affordances inherit token motion from their primitives: file tabs interpolate color and border over ThemeTokens.motionQuick with the easeStandard curve, as do the copy button and the scroll bars.
codeBlock.animationsBullet3Qt: All transitions are guarded by ThemeTokens.animationsEnabled; when disabled, durations resolve to zero and animations stop.

scrollArea.overviewDesc: Interactive playground demonstrating cross-stack scrollbar styling, stepper pagination, and dynamic hot-zone expansion.
scrollArea.horizontalDesc: Hover over the bottom scrollbar to reveal the left and right stepper buttons.
scrollArea.dualAxisDesc: When content exceeds both width and height, both scrollbars render with a synchronized corner piece.
scrollArea.hotZoneDesc: Traditional narrow scrollbars are difficult to target with a mouse pointer. ChaSet introduces a compact 0.5rem transparent interaction hot-zone paired with an animated visual indicator that expands from 0.25rem (idle) to 0.5rem (hover) with 150ms cubic easing.
scrollArea.hotZoneIdle: Idle State: 0.25rem slim indicator bar, non-intrusive.
scrollArea.hotZoneHover: Hover State: Expands to 0.5rem with high visual affordance.
scrollArea.hotZoneHit: Hit Area: 0.5rem compact trigger box prevents accidental cursor capture.
scrollArea.stepperDesc: Hovering the scrollbar reveals two-end stepper action buttons:
scrollArea.verticalTop: Top: To Top (Home) & Page Up (85% viewport step)
